2027-01-01.title: The Naming of our Lord · New Year's Day
2027-01-01.verse: After eight days had passed, it was time to circumcise the child; and he was called Jesus, the name given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

2027-01-03.title: Second Sunday after Yaldo
readings: The boy Samuel grows before the Lord
They shall mount up with wings like eagles
Here is the Lamb of God
2027-01-03.verse: Here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!

2027-01-06.title: Denho · The Baptism of our Lord
readings: You are my Son, the Beloved
Rebekah gives water at the well
The river flowing from the Temple
Draw water from the wells of salvation
Baptised in the name of the Lord Jesus
The water of rebirth and renewal
The Baptism of Jesus in the Jordan
2027-01-06.verse: This is my Son, the Beloved, with whom I am well pleased.

2027-01-10.title: First Sunday after Denho
readings: The burning bush: I AM WHO I AM
The Lord has comforted his people
Chosen in Christ before the foundation of the world
The call of the first disciples
2027-01-10.verse: Follow me, and I will make you fish for people.

2027-01-17.title: Second Sunday after Denho
readings: Jesus returns to Galilee in the power of the Spirit
I am the Lord who sanctifies you
Wisdom at the beginning of creation
He shall feed his flock in the strength of the Lord
Look to the rock from which you were hewn
Be holy, for I am holy
2027-01-17.verse: Very truly, I tell you, you will see heaven opened and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man.

2027-01-24.title: Kohne Sunday · Commemoration of the Departed Priests
readings: Aaron anointed for an everlasting covenant
Paul's farewell to the elders of Ephesus
2027-01-24.verse: Remember your leaders, those who spoke the word of God to you; consider the outcome of their way of life, and imitate their faith.

2027-01-31.title: Aneede Sunday · Commemoration of the Departed Faithful
readings: Jacob is gathered to his people
New heavens and a new earth
We will be with the Lord for ever
The dead will hear the voice of the Son of God
2027-01-31.verse: Very truly, I tell you, anyone who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and does not come under judgment, but has passed from death to life.

2027-01-02.title: Saturday after New Year · Mar Baselios and Mar Gregorios
readings: The Lord's servant must be kindly to everyone
You must be born from above
2027-01-02.verse: Jesus answered, “Very truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God without being born of water and Spirit.

2027-01-04.title: Monday after the Second Sunday after Yaldo · Prophet Malachi; St Kuriakose Elias Chavara
readings: Without faith it is impossible to please God
2027-01-04.verse: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

2027-01-05.title: Tuesday after the Second Sunday after Yaldo · Eve of Denho
readings: Grow up in every way into Christ
2027-01-05.verse: Consider the lilies, how they grow: they neither toil nor spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these.

2027-01-07.title: Thursday after Denho · The Praise of St John the Baptist
readings: A servant of the gospel by the gift of God's grace
Among those born of women no one is greater than John
2027-01-07.verse: I tell you, among those born of women no one is greater than John; yet the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

2027-01-08.title: Friday after Denho · Mar Stephanos, the First Martyr
readings: Devoted to the service of the saints
I send you prophets, sages and scribes
2027-01-08.verse: While they were stoning Stephen, he prayed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.” Then he knelt down and cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” When he had said this, he died.

2027-01-09.title: Saturday after Denho
readings: Will their faithlessness nullify the faithfulness of God?
You abandon the commandment of God and hold to human tradition
2027-01-09.verse: You abandon the commandment of God and hold to human tradition.

2027-01-11.title: Monday after the First Sunday after Denho · Mar Gregorios of Nyssa
readings: He gives the Spirit without measure
2027-01-11.verse: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all consolation, who consoles us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to console those who are in any affliction with the consolation with which we ourselves are consoled by God.

2027-01-12.title: Tuesday after the First Sunday after Denho · Mar Thevodosios the Abbot
readings: The light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ
It is lawful to do good on the sabbath
2027-01-12.verse: For it is the God who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

2027-01-13.title: Wednesday after the First Sunday after Denho
readings: Prayers for everyone; one mediator, Christ Jesus
2027-01-13.verse: Why do you see the speck in your neighbor's eye, but do not notice the log in your own eye?

2027-01-14.title: Thursday after the First Sunday after Denho · The Forty Martyrs of Sinai; St Devasahayam
readings: Justified by his grace as a gift
Do not fear those who kill the body
2027-01-14.verse: But even the hairs of your head are all counted. Do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.

2027-01-15.title: Friday after the First Sunday after Denho · Commemoration of Mary, Mother of God, for the Seeds
readings: God supplies seed to the sower
2027-01-15.verse: He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your seed for sowing and increase the harvest of your righteousness.

2027-01-16.title: Saturday after the First Sunday after Denho · The Bonds of St Peter
readings: Remember your leaders; Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever
2027-01-16.verse: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

2027-01-18.title: Monday after the Second Sunday after Denho · First Day of the Fast of the Ninevites
readings: Jonah flees from the presence of the Lord
He humbled himself and became obedient
2027-01-18.verse: For just as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the sea monster, so for three days and three nights the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth.

2027-01-19.title: Tuesday after the Second Sunday after Denho · Second Day of the Fast of the Ninevites · Mar Macarios
2027-01-19.verse: Keep awake therefore, for you do not know on what day your Lord is coming.

2027-01-20.title: Wednesday after the Second Sunday after Denho · Third Day of the Fast of the Ninevites · St Sebastian
readings: Jonah's prayer from the belly of the fish
2027-01-20.verse: saying, “I called to the LORD out of my distress, and he answered me; out of the belly of Sheol I cried, and you heard my voice.

2027-01-21.title: Thursday after the Second Sunday after Denho · Conclusion of the Fast of the Ninevites · St Agnes
readings: Abraham pleads for Sodom; Joshua's prayer
Should I not be concerned about Nineveh?
God revealed his Son to me
Something greater than Jonah is here
2027-01-21.verse: For just as Jonah became a sign to the people of Nineveh, so the Son of Man will be to this generation.

2027-01-22.title: Friday after the Second Sunday after Denho · Mar Timotheos the Apostle
readings: Fight the good fight of the faith
Not to abolish but to fulfil
2027-01-22.verse: Fight the good fight of the faith; take hold of the eternal life, to which you were called and for which you made the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.

2027-01-23.title: Saturday after the Second Sunday after Denho
readings: The mediator of a better covenant
2027-01-23.verse: But Jesus has now obtained a more excellent ministry, and to that degree he is the mediator of a better covenant, which has been enacted through better promises.

2027-01-25.title: Monday after Kohne Sunday · Conversion of St Paul
readings: The call of Saul on the road to Damascus
He proclaims the faith he once tried to destroy
That they may all be one
2027-01-25.verse: that they may all be one. As you, Father, are in me and I am in you, may they also be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.

2027-01-26.title: Tuesday after Kohne Sunday · Republic Day of India
readings: You are a letter of Christ
Give to the emperor what is the emperor's, and to God what is God's
2027-01-26.verse: They answered, “The emperor's.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to the emperor the things that are the emperor's, and to God the things that are God's.”

2027-01-27.title: Wednesday after Kohne Sunday
readings: Christ and the Church: a great mystery
Marriage is not to be broken
2027-01-27.verse: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her,

2027-01-28.title: Thursday after Kohne Sunday · St Thomas Aquinas
readings: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever
I am the way, and the truth, and the life
2027-01-28.verse: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

2027-01-29.title: Friday after Kohne Sunday · Mar Ignatius Noorono of Antioch
readings: Present your bodies as a living sacrifice
Unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies
2027-01-29.verse: Very truly, I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains just a single grain; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.

2027-01-30.title: Saturday after Kohne Sunday · Mar Jacob Aphrahat, the Persian Sage
readings: The tree is known by its fruit
2027-01-30.verse: The good person brings good things out of a good treasure, and the evil person brings evil things out of an evil treasure.
